a: Bitperfect Player has one annual subscription with every feature and no ads. Limited Founder offer: $19.95 a year if you subscribe by May 31, 2027. That price stays yours on every renewal while you stay subscribed. From June 1, 2027, new subscribers pay the standard price of $29.95 a year. Cancel and come back after that date, and you pay the standard price. 14-day free trial for eligible new customers. Cancel during the trial and you pay nothing. The plan covers five devices with the Google Play Store. More devices are a paid in-app add-on. You pay and cancel in Google Play.
